notes: Accepted differences between the live API Lambda package and a fresh full-package build of main (aws/functions/api plus npm ci --omit=dev from its lockfile), one section per environment. guarded-{staging,production}-lambda-rebuild.yml inspect reports every live-vs-candidate difference; apply is refused while any difference is not listed here. members: source files whose bytes change (exact live and accepted SHA-256). added: files absent live (accepted SHA-256). removed: live files the build drops (live SHA-256). dependencies: node_modules packages added, removed or re-versioned, keyed by package path. status pending_inspect means the section has not been filled from an inspect run yet; a filled section is a reviewed plan change. Filling a section never deploys. Node modules are compared by package path and version, not byte for byte: the install is reproducible from the lockfile but the live package was built by other tooling.
